verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an identity-verification platform, since some vendors offer on-premise deployment, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hosted or on-premise deployment of the core product. The docs describe a cloud API with sandbox and live environments, and state that Entrust hosts the verification journey on the customer's behalf.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
